技術專題

高雜訊專業語音辨識研究

Speech Recognition Research for Noisy Professional Audio

分開評估專業通訊的自動轉寫與後續資訊抽取，保留原始語句供研究人員核對。

產業問題與工程挑戰

專業通訊常有背景雜訊、縮寫和領域術語。原始轉寫的錯誤可能傳至後續資訊抽取。

工程限制

後處理可能讓文字更順暢，也可能改變原始資訊。研究需區分轉寫錯誤、術語校正與抽取錯誤。

技術方法與架構

實作與交付

創辦人公開研究履歷列出急救語音辨識評估，以及使用語言模型做專業術語校正與資訊抽取的兩階段流程。公開資料定義了研究方法。

成果

公開來源支持雙階段語音研究敘事。語音辨識與下游資訊抽取各自有驗證範圍。

  • 公開研究方法與流程說明
  • 語音辨識評估與下游抽取的分段設計

公開摘要支持研究流程，聲學條件、量測結果與適用性需另依已核准的研究報告驗證。

Technical Note

Speech Recognition Research for Noisy Professional Audio

Academic Research Collaboration · Engineering Evaluation

Evaluate speech recognition and structured information extraction separately, with a trace from the extracted information back to the utterance.

Open full English page 繁體中文 Plan a project Technical diagram

Industry problem and engineering challenge

Professional radio traffic often contains background noise, abbreviations and domain-specific terminology. Transcription errors can carry into information extraction.

Engineering constraints

Post-processing can improve readability and also change the meaning. The evaluation needs to distinguish recognition errors, terminology correction and extraction errors.

Technical approach and architecture

Implementation and deliverables

The founder's public research profiles describe research into speech recognition for emergency communications and a second stage for domain terminology correction and information extraction.

Outcome

The public descriptions establish a research workflow with distinct evaluation boundaries for recognition and downstream extraction.

  • Public research methodology and workflow description
  • Separate evaluation design for recognition and extraction

Validation and evidence

Public summaries document the workflow. Acoustic conditions, measured performance and applicability each require a released research evaluation.
